bra: The only hub in nine that runs the three-question test honestly: lines any brush brand could sign are marked ✅ in the competitor column, price and CTA lines are marked "Not applicable" — the table is a test here, not decoration.

Every source is named or marked "guess" exactly as the rules ask; the parent PD_1_H2 is cited with purchases, CPA and break-even (15 purchases, CPA 147 kr against 307 kr, +2 410 kr contribution); PD_1_H4/H5 change only seconds 0–3 of the winner's file.
Store terms are right: `Fri frakt inom Sverige`, `14 dagars ångerrätt enligt lag`, Klarna — `never 30 dagars öppet köp` is in every Rules block; the store name never appears.

Locked facts verified against the page (read live from the product page 2026-09-24): 9 rods × 41 cm, 3,69 m, 100 mm brush, hex adapter, `Når bakom kaminen eller torktumlaren`, `Följer krökar där en stel stång fastnar`, `Bygg bara den längd du behöver`; the six-rod-photo warning protects the count claim.
PD_4_1 and PD_4_H1: real soot or the brief is held — never staged.
missat: Seven briefs ship a line the writer's own test marked competitor-signable (`Det här satt i röret.`, `Borsten kommer ut svart.`, `Sotet borstas loss.`, `Skruva ihop stängerna en efter en.`, `Klart på minuter.`, `Jag sotade kaminröret själv. Utan sotare.`, `599 kr. Men inte längre.`) with a justification next to the ✅. The copy rule is the other way round: a line that fails is rewritten until it carries something only this set can say (the bend, the nine rods, 3,69 m) — honesty about the failure does not license shipping it.

Eight videos have no shot-level direction table — the rule applies from 2026-09-21, the round's own date; PD_1_H4/H5 edit three seconds, but the six new videos leave picture, effect and source to the editor.

G_2_1 cites `product page "perfekt julklapp"` — the phrase is not on the page (read live from the product page 2026-09-24); the gift angle is a guess and is already marked one, so drop the false citation.
PD is used for five different angles (reach, comparison, proof, scale, specs) — the Variables line names them, the ad name does not; the next /cs groups by name.
`Klart på minuter.` (PD_4_H1) is a timing claim the page does not make — film it and write the real time, or drop it.
The old `Variables:` line (angle · hook-type · format · proof · offer · talker) is used instead of VARIABELTAGGAR; no Memo, no `AI content:` line, no COPY CARD.
This product has no memory in the repo — the Feedback row in the hub is its memory.
regler: A line the test marks competitor-signable is rewritten before the brief goes out — add the thing only this set can say (nine rods, the bend through the elbow, 3,69 m) — never shipped with a justification next to the ✅.
Every video written from 2026-09-21 carries one direction row per script line (Audio · On-screen text · Picture · Effect · Source · Latitude) — eight videos this round have none.
VARIABELTAGGAR, `Memo:` and `AI content:` replace the old Variables line, and a phrase quoted "from the page" must be on the page — `perfekt julklapp` is not.
